theme_strategy: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Modern Fintech (Stripe/Linear vibe). Authoritative, precise, data-dense, and highly accessible. Clean white/zinc interfaces for the main ERP to ensure readability, and a sleek dark mode for the central admin licensing panel.

headings.usage: Page titles, card headers, section titles. Use font-semibold to font-bold. E.g., text-2xl tracking-tight font-semibold.

body.usage: Data tables, descriptions, standard text. Ensures high legibility for numbers and dense data. E.g., text-sm text-zinc-600.

data_values.usage: Primary data points in tables or cards (e.g., Customer Name, Total Amount).

monospaced.usage: Invoice numbers, IDs, and Verifactu hashes/footprints. If not available, use any clean monospace font.

layouts.overall_structure: Transition from top navbar to a Left Sidebar (collapsible, 240px width) for main navigation, creating an F-Pattern hierarchy. Top header should contain Breadcrumbs, Global Search, and Action Buttons.
layouts.page_header: Includes Title, Subtitle/Summary Chips (e.g., 'Total: 124 Orders'), and primary actions (e.g., 'Nuevo Cliente') aligned to the right.

data_tables.structure: Edge-to-edge inside a card with rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden. Use Shadcn Table component.
data_tables.headers: Sticky headers (top-0, z-10) with bg-zinc-50/90 backdrop-blur-sm, text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wider.
data_tables.rows: Height 48px-52px. Hover state: hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-colors. Subtle border-b border-zinc-100.
data_tables.alignment: Left-align text, Right-align numbers/currency, Center-align status badges.
data_tables.density: Compact but readable. Group primary info (e.g., Name) with secondary info (e.g., Email) below it in the same cell using text-sm and text-xs text-zinc-500.
data_tables.actions: Use a sticky right column or explicit 'more-vertical' dropdown menu for row actions (Edit/Delete).

layouts.central_admin_panel: Strict Dark Mode. Use zinc-950 background, zinc-900 for cards, zinc-800 for borders. Primary accent shifts to indigo-500. This highly differentiates the internal admin from the client-facing ERP.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use subtle ambient shadows for cards: shadow-sm (0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)). Drop shadow for dropdowns: shadow-lg border border-zinc-200.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-lg for cards and dialogs, rounded-md for inputs and buttons, rounded-full for status pills and avatars.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid crisp borders (border-zinc-200). Remove unnecessary internal borders to let whitespace act as a divider.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Never show an empty table. Use a centered layout inside the table container with an abstract icon (lucide/phosphor), a heading, a muted description, and a primary CTA.

motion.micro_interactions: Subtle translate-y-[-1px] and shadow-md on hover for clickable cards. Use simple Tailwind transitions (transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out) for hover states.
motion.dialogs: Smooth fade-in and scale-in (95% to 100%) for Create/Edit modals.

components_strategy.tables: Enhance shadcn/ui tables. Add row density and right-aligned numbers.
components_strategy.status_pills: Use Shadcn Badge component, overridden with semantic colors (soft background, strong text, thin ring border via ring-1 ring-inset).
components_strategy.kpi_cards: Top dashboard cards: Value text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight, with a small trend indicator (+5.2%) in green/red.
components_strategy.avatars: Use Shadcn Avatar for Client/Supplier initials (e.g., 'JD' for John Doe) to add visual anchors in lists.
components_strategy.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs for Facturas Recibidas / Emitidas. Style them as pill tabs or clean underline tabs.
components_strategy.ai_import_card: For 'Facturas Recibidas (AI PDF import)', create a dedicated dropzone area with dashed borders (border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50/50), an icon, and a 'Consumo IA' progress bar/stat card nearby.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially secondary text-zinc-500, meets APCA/WCAG AA contrast ratios against white/zinc-50 backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY. Ensure all existing data-testids remain intact. Add descriptive data-testid to any new interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='btn-create-client').

icons.library: Lucide (existing). Set strokeWidth to 1.5 for a cleaner, premium look.
icons.usage: Use icons in the sidebar, in empty states (large and muted), and in KPI cards.

image_urls.description: Abstract blue geometry. Use purely as a very subtle, low-opacity background decoration for the Central Admin Login or AI Processing empty state.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor the current basic top-nav layout into a professional left-sidebar layout (Stripe/Linear style) combined with a top header for breadcrumbs.

Enhance all CRUD Data Tables (Clientes, Proveedores, Artículos, Pedidos, Albaranes, Facturas): Make them crisp with sticky headers, zebra/hover states, grouped cell data (Name + Email), right-aligned amounts, and status badges.
Implement a polished Dark Mode exclusively for the Central Admin licensing panel.
For the 'Facturas Recibidas' AI PDF import, build a prominent dashed dropzone UI and a distinct 'Consumo IA' widget.
Ensure the Verifactu section shows the QR code gracefully in the details drawer/dialog.
DO NOT break existing functionality or remove existing data-testids. Use existing Tailwind and Shadcn setup (.js files), but override styles to match these guidelines.
Keep typography scales constrained: H1 max text-3xl for dashboards, use Cabinet Grotesk for display and IBM Plex Sans for data tables.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. A premium B2B SaaS feels intentional in every pixel.
Create depth through layered design elements (subtle borders, off-white backgrounds, drop shadows).
Use glass-morphism effects carefully, mostly for sticky headers or dropdowns (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80).
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. transition: all). Target specific properties like transition-colors or transition-transform.
Do NOT center align the app container. Dashboards must be left-aligned and fill the viewport.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-md, crisp padding, clear active states).
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdowns MUST have a solid/blurred background.
Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements.
